buildCommand: test -s web/index.html && { [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" != "threejs-rebuild" ] || { test -n "$TURSO_DATABASE_URL" && test -n "$TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN"; }; } && echo "Using YAKOLAK web build"
ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "threejs-rebuild" ]; then exit 1; fi; git log -1 --pretty=%s | grep -q '^\[flash-ready\]' && exit 1 || exit 0
